name: Камино България
description_md:
Kamino Bulgaria is a waymarked hiking route in BG spanning 80.8 km. It features 1382 m of ascent and 1714 m of descent.

The difficulty is hard, derived from distance and ascent, with a walking time of about 24 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. This trail is part of the national waymarked hiking network. Nearby places include Church St. St. Cyril and Methodius within 100 m, Archaeological Museum within 100 m, and Church of the Theotokos in Sozopol within 300 m.
